extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / editors (particularly new users wanting to create an article)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural requirements for creating a new Wikipedia article (checking for existing pages, account/autoconfirmation requirements, title/capitalization issues, and troubleshooting deleted or not-yet-visible pages).

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users must have an account and meet the autoconfirmed status (per Wikipedia rules) before creating new pages; otherwise use alternate mechanisms (article wizard, request page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot directly create the page (e.g., not autoconfirmed), prepare a draft via the article wizard or ask experienced editors to create the page via the 'request a new article' process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles first
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Pepsi Live for Now Moments (advertisement)" in existing articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a page, thoroughly search Wikipedia for existing coverage or alternative titles/spellings to avoid duplication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for pages that link to this title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inspect backlinks to find mentions, redirects, or related coverage that may indicate an existing article under a different title.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recently created pages may be temporarily invisible
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you suspect the page exists but cannot see it, wait briefly and/or purge the page cache to force an update.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title capitalization and redirect guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When creating or locating a page, try alternative capitalizations and, where appropriate, create redirects so searches for variants point to the canonical page.

rubrics_metrics.name: If the page was deleted, consult the deletion log
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see Why was the page I created deleted?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the deletion log and related help pages to understand deletion reasons and whether the topic can be recreated compliant with policies.
